ui.about.title: About Watchcoin (WTC)
ui.about.p1: Watchcoin is a task-and-earn app. You do short, simple tasks, such as watching a video, liking, subscribing or answering a poll, and you earn WTC tokens for each one.
ui.about.h1: At least 5 new tasks every day, each with its own reward
ui.about.h2: A daily streak bonus, and a spin of the prize wheel once you finish all of the day's tasks
ui.about.h4: 50 WTC for every friend you invite who finishes a task
ui.about.h5: Premium plans give you more tasks each day
ui.about.launchIn: WTC is set to launch in {t}
ui.about.launchSoon: The WTC launch date is coming soon
ui.about.launchP: {launch}. Until then, your WTC balance stays safe in the app. Transfers and converting your WTC will open after launch, and the details will be shared in the app before they do.
ui.about.usdtP: The USDT amount you see is an estimate. It uses the app's own rate (1 WTC = {p} USDT) and is not a price on any market. After launch, the real market value of WTC can be higher, lower, or nothing at all.
ui.about.readP: Nobody can promise that WTC will be worth money, or that anyone will make a profit by holding it. Earn WTC for fun or as a bonus. Only pay for a premium plan if you are comfortable losing that money, and never borrow money to take part.
ui.about.fairP: One account per person. Bots, fake accounts and cheating lead to a ban and loss of tokens. Have a question or a problem? Send it from the Me tab.
